P168-N001 live measurement probe on merged #168 at c7d660c, daemon PID25230.

The native directory-routes operation (two real regenerations plus one build and store/formatting work) completed in 31.73 ms with 9 role documents, 8 active and 11 unique scope rows. The requested own-role memory write completed in 2,382.55 ms and its window recorded seven Git plus two ddocs launches. These are whole-operation/write bounds, not isolated rebuild durations.

This note is the one timed output write. Its returned commit, whole-write duration and counter deltas are saved in `pr168-output-write-timing.json`. A subsequent final note will consolidate the measurements; its publication is not part of this timed probe.
